content: Design Settings » Homepage » Select Content to Display » About Website and Join Offer Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000098610 About Website and Join Offer This article goes over the available settings to edit the About Website and Join Offer section on the homepage of the website. This section is meant to be displayed on the homepage exclusively. Visual Guide of the About Website and Join Offer Settings 1. Hide On Mobile? This setting controls if this section will be displayed on mobile devices or not. No This will show the section on mobile devices. Yes This will hide the section on mobile devices 2. Element Background This setting controls the background color for the Join Offer module. 3. Element Border This setting controls the border color for the Join Offer module. 4. Element Background This setting controls the background color for the About Website module. 5. Element Border This setting controls the border color for the About Website module. 6. Join Offer Title This setting controls the title for the Join Offer module. 7. Title Color This setting controls the title color for the Join Offer module. 8. About Website Title This setting controls the title for the About Website module. 9. Title Color This setting controls the title color for the About Website module. 10. Join Offer Text This setting controls the Join Offer Text for the Join Offer module. This module has available a Froala editor so that the message can be edited and customized according to website's needs. To learn more about the Froala editor, navigate to the following link: Everything About Froala WYSIWYG Text Editor 11. About Website Text This setting controls the About Website Text for the About Website module. This module has available a Froala editor so that the message can be edited and customized according to website's needs. To learn more about the Froala editor, navigate to the following link: Everything About Froala WYSIWYG Text Editor 12. Join Offer Link Text This setting controls the Join Offer Link Text in the Join Offer Link module. 13. Select Link Button Color This setting controls the Join Offer Link Button Color in the Join Offer Link module. To learn more about how to set the default button colors, navigate to the following link: Design Settings » Button Colors 14. Join Offer Link URL This setting controls the Join Offer Link URL in the Join Offer Link module. This is where people will be taken to when clicking on this call to action, this setting will only accept relative links. 15. About Website Link Text This setting controls the Join Offer Link Text in the Join Offer Link module. 16. Select Link Button Color This setting controls the About Website Link Button Color in the About Website module. To learn more about how to set the default button colors, navigate to the following link: Design Settings » Button Colors 17. About Website Link URL This setting controls the About Website Link URL in the About Website module. This is where people will be taken to when clicking on this call to action, this setting will only accept relative links.
